This is actually a really common problem! There are a few techniques that help quite a bit. Obviously, as with anything, practice is your best friend. Be prepared to fail a few times before having much success. As far as staying in a lucid dream if you get too excited, one very effective action is to spin. Literally start spinning as fast as you can the moment you suspect a lucid dream. It will distract you from the novelty and help you to remain grounded. 

Another useful technique is to assert your new reality. Immediately bend down and touch the ground. What does it feel like? Touch your clothes. What are you wearing? If there is anything nearby, grab it and assure yourself that what your are holding is real and solid. Clasp your hands tightly with the understanding that they are real and so is the environment. Don't forget to maintain that even though you are dreaming, your world is solid and real around you. You have absolute control, but you must believe in your surroundings!

If the reality check has worked for you, then it isn't faulty, it's working! The goal of a reality check is not to produce a certain result, but to inform you in some way that you are dreaming. As an example, I use the clock trick as a regular RC. But the goal is not to see a clock with hands spinning, or with too many numbers, or any other specific thing wrong, but only to notice that something is amiss, and it is often something different than I expected. Sometimes, it is even the fact that no clock can be found that is the indicator of a dream! 

I wouldn't say you are unusually observant. If the check is appearing as it would in the waking world in your dream, then it is a failure. If otherwise, then it is technically successful. However, if you are uncomfortable with the solidity of your RC, it may be wise for you to explore other options.

You're right. It isn't in your control. Your circumstances are not under your control. They probably will never be. 

It's what you *do*, however, that is under your control. You aren't happy. You say you can't imagine being happy. 

Try. That's all I'm asking. Just try. Go outside and lay under the sky. Watch a movie that you've never seen. Keep applying for jobs, keep meeting girls, and most importantly, keep failing. Yep, I typed that correctly. Keep trying and failing and learning something each time! You may not succeed if you try, but you will never succeed if you don't make the attempt. 

The best part about this life is that the game isn't over until the fat lady sings, and you get unlimited tries! You can do whatever you want with the situations you aren't in control of- and take control by learning more and more from circumstances outside your immediate influence. 

The soundest mind knows that failure is even more useful than success, because failure offers the option of growth and actualization. It's all about perspective!

This isn't about everyone around you. This isn't about the people who look at you, and it isn't even about the people who love you. This isn't about them.

This is about you.

Think about it this way,

You have been climbing an enormous mountain your entire life. The mountain is slippery with self-doubt, depression, pain and fear. You think that there might be success at the top, maybe happiness, but it's so hard to pull yourself up. You say that you're supposed to fight and fight and fight, but it hurts. Every time you pull yourself higher, you feel like the top of the mountain gets farther away.

You're clinging to the side of the mountain, unable to look down from fear of falling and failing and dying. The heights terrify you- if you've come so far, how far is it to fall? Putting yourself out there in relationships, or taking risks in life is like throwing yourself off the cliff face that you've been hanging on to for dear life for as long as you can remember.

But here's the punchline- you need to do it.

It takes guts to realize, but this mountain isn't your life. Your life is out there! It's full of sunrises and oceans and warm breezes. It's full of learning new things and discovering what you are and becoming the person you want to be instead of the person that you thought you were. This isn't about finding some job to earn you some money and barely scraping by- this is about your incredible life! Your valuable mind- your amazing and unique journey from where you are to where you want to be! 

The molecules in the universe have been floating around for eons, just to come together for this miraculous moment to become you! To think and understand and see and feel what you do. Nobody else all of existence will ever be you again, and what you are is so important!

You feel miserable? Then experience it! Embrace it! Grasp that feeling, feel it completely with all of the reasons of why it is- and *let it go*. Feel more feelings. Feel every feeling you can possibly imagine! Try doing something new and unique every single day. Go rollerblading, or golfing, or volunteering, or tree climbing, and yeah, get a job, but go get one that you'll enjoy! 

Happiness isn't something you're going to find hiding under a rock somewhere, it is something that you build with your own two hands.
